# leadingedgevets

> Leading Edge Veterinary Services offers large and small animal care in Northwestern WI, from wellness exams and vaccines to dental care and surgery.

- Official website: https://www.leadingedgevets.com/
- Contact: 715-934-9055 / info@leadingedgevets.com

## Key pages

- [Book Online | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/book-online): Book the indoor arena at Bluestem Boarding & Equine Center online: see the rates and session times, then reserve a 30 minute session for $20.
- [Equine Boarding | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/equine-boarding): Stall and pasture board at Bluestem Boarding & Equine Center in Springbrook, WI, with a 120' x 80' indoor arena and flexible 1 to 12 month contracts.
- [Equine Center | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/equine-center): Bluestem Boarding & Equine Center, the epicenter for all things equine in Northern Wisconsin: an indoor event and boarding facility in Springbrook, WI.
- [Equine Events | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/equine-events): Events at Bluestem Boarding & Equine Center: the health requirements for day events and overnight events with stall board, from a negative Coggins test.
- [Bovine Producers Tour & Demo: 1pm | Leading Edge Vets](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/event-details-registration/bovine-producers-tour-demo-1pm): Bovine Producers Tour & Demo, Sat, Jun 17, 2023, 1:00-2:00 PM: a tour of the Leading Edge large animal hospital and a livestock handling demonstration.
- [Cattle Producers BBQ and Open House | Leading Edge Vets](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/event-details-registration/cattle-producers-bbq-and-open-house): Cattle Producers BBQ and Open House, Sat, Jun 17, 2023, 10:30 AM-2:00 PM: a tour of our large animal hospital, a livestock handling demo and food.
- [FAQ | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/faq): This is the clinics FAQ page to help direct you with questions contacting the clinic, what to do in an emergency and scheduling appointments.
- [Gallery | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/gallery): Photo gallery of Bluestem Boarding and Equine Center at Leading Edge Veterinary Services in Springbrook, WI: horses, pastures, trails and the arena.
- [Dairy | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/large-animal-services/dairy): Dairy services for all herds in Northern Wisconsin: herd health, VFD, calves and farm services, with portable ultrasound for early pregnancy checks.
- [Equine Reproduction | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/large-animal-services/equine-reproduction): Equine reproduction services: breeding management, breeding soundness exams, fresh and frozen semen analysis and artificial insemination for your horse.
- [Equine | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/large-animal-services/equine): Equine services at Leading Edge Veterinary Services: vaccinations, deworming, Coggins testing, lameness exams, dentistry, reproduction and emergencies.
- [Large Animal Services | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/large-animal-services/): Large animal care in northern Wisconsin: farm calls for cattle, horses, sheep, goats, swine and poultry, haul-in appointments and after hours emergencies.
- [Livestock | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/large-animal-services/livestock): Care for beef cattle, goats, sheep, alpacas, pigs and poultry: routine vaccines, deworming protocols, castrations and emergencies, with haul-in facilities.
- [Links | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/links): Small and large animal links to online pharmacies, pet food links, vaccination & deworming guidelines, articles and other resources.
- [Staff | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/meet-the-staff): Meet our wonderful staff that provides "Perfect Practice" service to our patients and clients. They're what makes everything happen.
- [Clinic Overview | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/new-clinic): The building process of the clinic at it's permanent location at N10120 County Highway M, Springbrook, WI 54875 | 715-934-9055 | info@leadingedgevets.com
- [Rebate Information | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/rebates): Rebates for prescription medications and flea, tick and heartworm preventatives: find your product's manufacturer rebate link and submit it there.
- [Indoor Arena Reservation | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/service-page/indoor-arena-reservation): Reserve the indoor arena at Bluestem Boarding & Equine Center, N10120 County Hwy M, Springbrook, WI: 30 minute sessions for $20, booked online.
- [Equine Shop | Equine Appreciation Dinner](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/shop): This is for our annual equine client appreciation dinner, to pre-order your annual exams, vaccinations and deworming (COGGINS IS NOT INCLUDED)
- [Boarding | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/small-animal-services/boarding): Indoor, climate controlled pet boarding at Leading Edge Veterinary Services, with check-ins Monday to Friday and check-outs on weekdays and weekends.
- [Canine Trainers | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/small-animal-services/canine-trainers): Local canine trainers who can help with everything from basic obedience to behavioral issues with your pooch. Reach out to them for classes and resources.
- [Dental Care and Oral Surgery | Leading Edge Vets](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/small-animal-services/dental-care-and-oral-surgery): Dental care and oral surgery for cats and dogs at Leading Edge Veterinary Services, with digital dental radiographs, cleanings and oral surgery.
- [Diagnostic Care | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/small-animal-services/diagnostic-care): Diagnostic care at Leading Edge Veterinary Services: an in-house laboratory, digital radiology and ultrasound, and send-out routine and specialty tests.
- [Grooming | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/small-animal-services/grooming): In house grooming provided by Emma Brauer. Clip, Clean and Shine your pup for a beautiful look. Bathe, Nail Trim, Ear Cleaning, Fur Clipping, Coat Blow Out
- [Small Animal Services | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/small-animal-services/): Preventive Care, Diagnostic Care, Dental Care, Surgical Care, Boarding, Grooming, Trainers. Online Pharmacy, Payment Assistance
- [Preventative Care | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/small-animal-services/preventative-care): Preventative care for your pet: wellness exams, vaccinations, parasite testing and control, microchipping, nutrition and behavior at Leading Edge Vets.
- [Surgical Care | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/small-animal-services/surgical-care): Minor and routine surgeries at Leading Edge Veterinary Services: spays and neuters, mass removal, enucleation and wound repair, with post-op laser therapy.

## Get in touch

- [Contact | Hayward, WI | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/contact): Here is the contact information you'll need to get in touch with our team. Calling by phone is our preferred method of communication.

## Guides and resources

- [2018 Bovine Client Lunch & Dinner](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/2018-bovine-client-lunch-dinner): Leave the cows in the barn and come out to the Spooner Ag Center for our annual Bovine Client appreciation event, with good food and useful door prizes.
- [2018 Equine Client Appreciation Dinner](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/2018-equine-client-appreciation-dinner): We at LEVS would like to invite all our equine clients to the Steakhouse in Hayward, WI for our annual appreciation dinner on Monday, March 12th at 5pm.
- [2026 Equine Vaccination & Deworming Protocols](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/2026-equine-vaccination-deworming-protocols): Download the 2026 Vaccination and Deworming Protocol (PDF) from Leading Edge Veterinary Services: this year's vaccine and deworming plan for horses.
- [April is National Heartworm Awareness Month!](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/april-is-national-heartworm-awareness-month): Did you know it takes just one mosquito for your pet to get heartworm disease? Our team at Leading Edge Vets can help you find the right prevention.
- [Beef Herd Health | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/beef-herd-health): Vaccination, deworming and confirming pregnancy are all important aspects of having and maintaining a thriving herd of beef cattle.
- [Bob Cat Adventures | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/bob-cat-adventures): Things are getting Wild at Leading Edge! We are the proud veterinarians for the zoo, Wilderness Walk, located right in Hayward, WI.
- [Calf Umbilical Surgery | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/calf-umbilical-surgery): The umbilical cord in calves carries blood, nutrients and waste between the placenta and the unborn calf. Good hygiene at calving prevents infections.
- [Canine Influenza | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/canine-influenza): Canine influenza, aka the Dog Flu. The dog flu is a highly contagious respiratory disease caused by the virus, canine influenza virus (CIV).
- [Dental Health Month: Tips for a Brighter Smile](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/celebrating-dental-health-month-in-february-tips-for-a-brighter-smile): February is Dental Health Month, a perfect time to focus on your pet's teeth and gums. Like humans, pets need regular dental care for their health.
- [Clinic Update: Interior Work | Leading Edge Vets](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/clinic-update-interior-work): We're starting to get the finishing touches on the new clinic. We painted the interior of the small animal hospital just this weekend.
- [Cold Weather Considerations | Leading Edge Vets](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/cold-weather-considersations): Companion animals aren't the only ones with cold weather considerations. Livestock, including horses, have their own unique needs, starting with shelter.
- [Dairy Calf Diarrhea - why are they at higher risk?](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/dairy-calf-diarrhea-why-are-they-at-higher-risk): Why young dairy calves, 1 to 14 days old, are at higher risk of diarrhea: their gut immunity, how often they are fed and how much milk they get.
- [Does your dog have a license ?](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/does-your-dog-have-a-license): It's that time of year again! Taxes are due for many Wisconsin residents and if you own a dog, that also means renewing your dog license.
- [Drinking Post-Frost Free Waterer, $ Saver!](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/drinking-post-frost-free-waterer-saver): Are you tired of chipping frozen water tanks and hauling water? Drinking Post Waterers are the answer, giving animals clean drinking water every time.
- [Equine Client Appreciation Dinner](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/equine-client-appreciation-dinner): Mark your calendars and hope for good weather! The 15th annual equine client appreciation dinner is set for March 4th, 2019 in Hayward, WI.
- [Equine Clients: RSVP by Feb 23, Orders Due Feb 27](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/equine-clients-rsvp-before-february-23rd-orders-due-february-27th): Friendly reminders for the upcoming Equine Client Appreciation Dinner: RSVP by February 23rd, and orders are due by February 27th.
- [Equine Cushings Disease | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/equine-cushings-disease): Cushing's Disease is an incurable but manageable progressive disorder common in aged horses, with an over secretion of hormones, mainly cortisol.
- [Equine Dental Care | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/equine-dental-care): Equine dentistry is an important part of horse health at all ages. Horses develop sharp enamel points that can crack, and cracked teeth are painful.
- [Equine Vaccination and Deworming Protocols](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/equine-vaccination-and-deworming-protocols): Our equine vaccination and deworming protocol, and what to do for a horse with an unknown vaccine history or over 18 months without vaccinations.
- [Fear Free Visits | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/fear-free-visits): Larry the golden is enjoying his vet visit! At Leading Edge Veterinary Services, we strive to provide care that is as compassionate as it is informative.
- [Feeding Your Horse | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/feeding-your-horse): Feeding Your Horse: What's in your horse's diet? This may seem like an easy question; grass hay, pasture, sweet feed, etc.
- [Flea and Tick Prevention - Sale going on Now!](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/flea-and-tick-prevention-sale-going-on-now): Do you have fleas? Topical Bravecto for cats lasts the entire life cycle of fleas and kills ticks, and we are offering 10% off flea and tick prevention.
- [Holiday Pet Preparedness | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/holiday-pet-preparedness): The holidays bring food, cheer and gatherings, and our pets join in. These tips help keep the season from ending in an emergency trip to the clinic.
- [Animal Care | Hayward, WI | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/): Leading Edge Veterinary Services offers services for horses, dairy and beef cattle, small animal, swine, small ruminants and camelids in northern WI.
- [International Veterinary Medicine Day](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/international-veterinary-medicine-day): In honor of international veterinary medicine day we'd like to give you a glimpse of some of the unique things our large animal veterinarians encounter.
- [Large Animal Surgical Procedures](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/large-animal-surgical-procedures): Leading Edge Veterinary Services offers basic large animal surgical procedures: calf hernia surgery, patent urachus repair, eye enucleations and more.
- [New Clinic Update | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/new-clinic-update): The new clinic started construction in August 2019 and will be home to a brand new small animal hospital, large animal hospital and equine center.
- [Northwest Wisconsin Graziers Network](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/northwest-wisconsin-graziers-network): 2026 Winter Graziers Conference, Saturday, March 7th. If you are interested in networking and furthering your knowledge on grazing practices, check it out.
- [Rabies Positive Puppy in Northwestern MN](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/rabies-positive-puppy-in-northwestern-mn): An unusual case of a rabid puppy in Minnesota reminds us all that rabies vaccines should not be shrugged off or forgotten about.

- [Sawyer County Vaccination Clinic](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/sawyer-county-vaccination-clinic): We are again working with Sawyer County to host a low-cost rabies vaccination and microchipping clinic. Cash and check only: rabies $15, microchip $20.
- [Small Animal Vaccine Clinic | Leading Edge Vets](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/small-animal-vaccine-clinic): Come in to the reduced cost Small Animal Vaccine Clinic at Leading Edge Veterinary Services on November 8th from 4-7pm to get your pets vaccinated.

- [The Tale of the Nail | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/the-tale-of-the-nail): Finding your horse three-legged lame in the pasture can be traumatic, but the worst case is rare. Stay calm first, then assess the situation safely.

- [West Nile Virus | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/west-nile-virus): West Nile Virus has been diagnosed in horses all over Wisconsin and Minnesota. Protect your animals today and get them vaccinated.
- [What's That in the Snow?! | Leading Edge Vets](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/what-s-that-in-the-snow): With the snow finally here, many of you may be wondering if you should be concerned if your horse's urine appears red in the snow.
- [Wolves and Livestock | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/blog/wolves-and-livestock): What should you do if you think your livestock is being threatened by wolves? Any suspected wolf attack must be reported to the USDA Wildlife Service.

- [Rabies | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/product-page/rabies): Equine rabies vaccine, a yearly vaccine ideally administered by a veterinarian to be legally recognized. Order it from the Leading Edge equine shop.
- [Strepvax IM | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/product-page/strepvax-im): Strepvax IM, a strangles vaccine for horses given in the muscle and well tolerated by most horses. Order it from the Leading Edge Veterinary Services shop.
- [Vetera E,W,T & West Nile | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/product-page/vetera-e-w-t-west-nile): Vetera E,W,T & West Nile, the low level vaccine all horses should get: Eastern and Western Equine Encephalitis, Tetanus and West Nile Virus.
- [Vetera Gold | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/product-page/vetera-gold): Vetera Gold protects horses against EIV, EHV-1 and EHV-4, EEE, WEE, Tetanus and West Nile Virus in one 1 mL dose: a high level vaccine from our shop.
- [Wellness Exam | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/product-page/wellness-exam): Pre-purchase an equine wellness exam at a discounted rate: heart and lung auscultation, a brief eye exam, an oral exam and a body condition assessment.
- [Zimectrin Gold | Leading Edge Veterinary Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/product-page/zimectrin-gold): Zimecterin Gold treats and controls tapeworms, large and small strongyles, pinworms, roundworms, bots and other parasites in horses. From our equine shop.
